\section{LCAO dual-basis weight identity (BvK ring)}
The direct spectral weight is the dual-basis projection through the sector Gram
\begin{equation} G^{\mathrm{sec}}_{(kn),(k'm)} = \langle kn|S|k'm\rangle, \qquad
W^{KJ}(k) = \sum_n \langle \widetilde{kn}|KJ\rangle \langle KJ|kn\rangle, \quad
\langle \widetilde{kn}| = \sum_{(k'm)} (G^{\mathrm{sec}})^{-1}_{(kn),(k'm)} \langle k'm| .
\end{equation}
On the toy ring ($N_C=2$, $L=4$, $P=2$) pristine weights equal $1$ to $5.6e-16$ at every $K$.
For translation-invariant overlaps the sector Gram is block-diagonal in $k$ (cross-$k$ blocks $<2e-15$), so per-$k$ blocks give identical weights.
Symbolic coefficient tables reproduce the numeric weights to $6.7e-16$ at both supercell momenta.
The clean image-sum form of Eq.~25 is an infinite-lattice identity;
on BvK rings the tables above are its exact reduction.
